profile.headline: Full Stack Engineer with expertise in building system applications in SQL, .NET Core, and React
profile.summary: I’m a Software Engineer with the capabilities to create, test, and deploy system and utility applications. With an understanding of design principals and design patterns I am able to achieve writing code that is reusable and versatile.

positions.title: Technical Leader, Mentor, Video Editor, and Admin
positions.description: Just trying to help as many people as I can.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Haynes Boone is an American Lawyer top 100 law firm, with about 650 lawyers in 19 offices around the world, providing services for more than 40 major legal practices. As a Software Engineer I work on a team that writes applications that are used throughout the firm. 

•	Created a full-scale system utilizing Okta's oAuth technology to secure API endpoints with .Net 7 and a mobile application with React Native to help connect previous Partners and Associates of the firm to current Partners, which brought in more potential revenue.
•	Researched and developed migration from standalone applications into a unified single repository under NX.Dev, which allowed us to keep NPM packages up-to-date, increasing development and productivity. 
•	Utilized Azure Dev-Ops to create multiple CI/CD, allowing client applications and APIs to stay updated with the latest environment deployments.
•	Created a floor plan map with Angular that helped the firm keep up-to-date information on employee seating.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft SQL Server · React.js · Azure DevOps Server · C# · .Net

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Gardere is a law firm with more than 230 attorneys which cover more than 40 different areas of practice serving clients from Texas, Denver, and Mexico. As an Applications Developer I work on creating Applications, Utilities, and Systems that are used internally throughout the firm.  

Responsibilities included but not limited to
•	Create, Test, and Deploy Applications, Utilities, And Systems
•	Enhance and maintain applications to grow with business needs
•	Provide support assistance with in house applications and data related inquiries.
•	Assist with SQL Server Maintenance 
•	Assist with IIS Server Maintenance and Stability

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description:
Transamerica offers various Insurance, Investments, and Retirement plans that are competitive in today’s market. As with any company there are processes in place that must be maintained in order to insure business transactions are processed correctly. As a Systems Analyst I worked on a small team, utilizing Agile with Scrum, to maintain and update the Credit Insurance System. 

Responsibilities included but not limited to,
•	Monthly on call rotation,
•	Maintenance on internal and external websites (C#, ASP.NET)
•	Maintenance on internal Window Form Applications (Delphi6)
•	Maintenance on scheduled processes written in VB.Net and monitored by BMC ControlM.
•	Maintenance on data-related issues (SQL Server 2005).
